notes: THE DOCUMENT CONTRADICTS ITSELF ON REPORT TYPE: the marked box is 'Seven days preceding the PRIMARY Election', yet the cover, affirmation and every page footer are dated 10/28/2024 - a general-election-week date - and the chunk file / filename call it the General report. Transcribed from the form; a human should note that the marked report type cannot be reconciled with the report date. Office line reads 'TREASURER' (agrees with the chunk). Amendment = No. FAINT MARKS ON p2: the first writing band of Schedule A (y 17.9-18.1 pct) carries broken specks confined to the DATE column (x 8.2-13.9% and 16.0-16.3%); re-rendered at 800 dpi they are disconnected fragments with no legible glyph, and there is no accompanying name, address or amount anywhere on the row. No row is emitted and no value is invented; the filer's own zero glyphs in the page subtotal, page total and Box B are consistent with an empty schedule. Flagged for a human eye. DECIMAL SEPARATOR: at 600 dpi the separator in '582.68' reads comma-like in this filer's hand; the arithmetic settles it as a decimal point (582.68 + 14.57 + 150.00 = 747.25 = the printed subtotal, the printed total, Box D and Box E), so it is transcribed as a decimal point, not as a decimal comma. p3 also carries a photocopied ADDING-MACHINE TAPE (582.68** / 14.57+ / 150.00+ / 747.25* / '003') - corroboration, not fields, so not transcribed. PAGE 5 is a filer attachment (Cache County Clerk online payment receipt: Amount $582.68, Processing Fee $14.57, Total $597.25, processed 2 Jan 2024) corroborating rows 1 and 2; its Payer's Information reads 'Byron C McAllister' where the candidate signs 'Craig McAllister' - noted, not resolved, and not transcribed. PAGE 6 is a filer attachment that is ROTATED 90 degrees in the poppler render (its title axis runs vertically although pdfinfo reports rot 0): Cache County Republican Party, $150.00, '2x Individual Dinner Tickets ($75.00)', Craig McAllister, 01/11/2024 - corroborating row 3. Candidate street address, phone and email printed in the clear on the cover, and the payer address on p6, were discarded at read time.
